name: Site GPT
tagline: Describe a masterplan in plain language and get a live-editable 3D massing model.
description: Draws a site and sets a land-use composition mix from a 17-category palette, lets any individual building be reassigned type with live area/GFA stats, regenerates the whole massing from a typed natural-language instruction (e.g. 'Dense CBD'), and runs a sun-path simulation once the road hierarchy is set.

page.objective: Let a masterplan be iterated by describing changes in plain language, not by manually re-modelling each option.
page.problem: Testing masterplan alternatives — a different mix, a different road hierarchy — normally means re-modelling by hand for every option.
page.solution: A site and composition mix generate an initial 3D massing; any building can be click-edited, and a typed instruction regenerates the whole plan.

highlights.headline: A typed instruction regenerates the whole masterplan massing live.
points: Draw site, set composition — a 17-category land-use mix on a drawn or freehand site boundary.
Click-edit any building live — reassign a building's use and watch site-area/GFA stats update per use.
Type a prompt, regenerate plan — a natural-language instruction rebuilds the whole massing model.
Edit roads, simulate sun path — road hierarchy widths and a sun-path simulation for a chosen location, date, and hour.
